msg: Hi, I hope the following advice is useful for you in this task. There are 2 very important things to remember when playing this game. The Gnomes always appear in set pairs wearing the following colours - Orange and Brown, Green and Pink, Red and Yellow, and Blue and Pink. The style of clothes and hat is not important, only the colour they wear. The position of the gnomes on either the right or left of the screen is also not important. They always appear in these set pairs.The second important thing to remember is that the gnomes coloured Orange Green Red and Blue will take you to a Bright Forest with a red basket and the gnomes coloured Brown Pink Yellow and Purple will take you to a Dark Forest with a yellow basket.You need to try to get to the forest that will give you the most mushrooms each time, but the forest that provides the best rewards changes from time to time so try to concentrate on picking one group of gnomes such as the Orange Green Red and Blue ones and stick with them if rewards are good, or switch to picking the Brown Pink Yellow and purple ones if the rewards are bad. Swich back and forth between each group depending on how good the rewards are. Try to always get to the forest with the most mushrooms based on your  rewards from the last few picks. The advice above worked for me, though I must admit I favoured the Orange Green Red and Blue group of gnomes when I wasn't sure. It worked out well for me. The above advice works for both the x1 and x5 multiplier rounds but be sure to pay more attention to which group of gnomes and forest will give you the best rewards on the x5 rounds.Good Luck!
